title: voice reply (embedded)
description: An agent's reply, spoken. The value under the `dev.agentpod.voice_reply` content key of the MSC3245 voice message (`m.audio`) the hub posts after the agent's text reply. It names that text (`text_event_id`) so a client can draw the voice note with the text it speaks; it is not an `m.in_reply_to`, which would make other clients quote the text twice. Mirrors AgentPod's `VoiceReply` and the hub's `voiceReplyContent` (`apps/hub/src/services/matrix-as/voice-reply.ts`). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: The content's minor version. AgentPod sends 1. Additive changes raise it; a reader draws a higher version best-effort, never drops it.

text_event_id.description: The event id of the agent's text message this voice note speaks.

voice.description: The speech service's voice id, or a blend such as `af_heart:60+af_bella:40`.

seconds.description: Length of the audio in whole seconds.
